name: scientific-agent-skills
description: Turn any AI agent into an AI Scientist. The #1 Agent Skills library for science, used by 250,000+ scientists worldwide. 177 ready-to-use validated skills plus 100+ scientific databases covering biology, chemistry, medicine, and drug discovery. Compatible with Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, Pi, Antigravity, and the open Agent Skills standard.
one_liner: A free pack of 'cheat sheets' that teaches an AI assistant how to correctly use real scientific databases and lab software, instead of guessing.
buyer: A small biotech lab or academic research group that can't afford a dedicated bioinformatics hire but has scientists who already use AI coding assistants.
business_use_cases: A small biotech lab uses the drug-discovery and molecular docking skills to run early-stage screening analyses in-house instead of outsourcing to a CRO.
A university lab with no bioinformatics staff uses the sequencing and variant-annotation skills so a single biologist can run analyses a specialist would normally be hired for.
A scientific consulting firm uses the skill library as a force multiplier so a handful of consultants can credibly cover biology, chemistry, and genomics requests.

money_ideas.idea: Offer paid training, onboarding, and support for labs adopting it, since the library itself is free and open.
Build a hosted 'AI co-scientist' service on top of it for labs that don't want to manage local infrastructure, charging per seat.

steal_this: Package a 'set up your lab's AI co-scientist in a weekend' onboarding service: install the skills, connect the databases the lab actually uses, and charge a flat setup fee.
